## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Claims about Ecuadorian regulation cite the resolution and article; anything not yet published by the BCE is marked **[assumption]**
- [ ] Decisions that change how the system works are recorded in an [ADR](../docs/architecture/adr/README.md) or [RFC](../docs/rfcs/README.md)
- [ ] Domain terms match [the glossary](../docs/glossary.md) (*llave*, *integrante*, *red de pagos*)
- [ ] Public-facing Spanish follows [docs/spanish-style.md](../docs/spanish-style.md)
- [ ] `MANIFIESTO.md` and `site/src/pages/manifiesto.md` are still in sync (if either changed)
- [ ] No credentials, keys, certificates, or real account data — not even as fixtures
- [ ] `cd site && npm run build` passes (if `site/` changed)
